testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.text: Urban Cafe is my favorite place to relax and work. The coffee is amazing and the ambiance is perfect!

testimonials.name: Rajesh Kumar
testimonials.text: Best espresso in the city! The staff is friendly and the service is excellent. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Anita Patel
testimonials.text: Love the pastries here! Fresh, delicious, and reasonably priced. Perfect for breakfast!

testimonials.name: Vikram Singh
testimonials.text: Took my family here for brunch and everyone loved it. Great food, great coffee, great vibes!

testimonials.name: Maya Desai
testimonials.text: The ambiance is incredible! Perfect for meetings or just hanging out with friends. The menu is diverse too.

testimonials.name: Arjun Nair
testimonials.text: This is my go-to place for coffee. The baristas really know their craft. Every cup is perfect!
